text:
jess: Quick pulse — we want the customer-facing release announcement (blog + post) to go live Thu 10:00am PT. Need: final changelog link, docs URL, canary timing, and one-sentence benchmark blurb for the PR. @tom @ali @eric

Tom: Changelog draft is up at https://redwood.in/changelog/v1.4.3 — still adding a tiny ops note. Canary plan: start Wed 2:00pm PT for 10% traffic, monitor 2h, then ramp to 100% by Thu 10:00am PT if no regressions.

ali: Docs team will push the GA docs on Wed 8:30pm PT. Final URL will be https://docs.redwood.in/release/v1.4.3 — I'll post the live link here as soon as it's published. Need the short product blurb from marketing to drop into the top of the guide.

jess: Perfect — can you post the live link by Wed 9pm PT so we can bake it into the announcement? Also, we'll want a 20-word blurb for the docs header and a 140-char social copy for the launch post.

eric: For benchmarks — we have median token latency improvements of ~18% on 8k-context workloads vs previous runtime when using the new batching heuristics. Draft blurb: "~18% median token latency on 8k prompts; 2.3x throughput at 99th percentile under steady-state loads." Is that too geeky?

jess: That's great — keep the more technical numbers for the blog and use a simpler line for social: "Faster inference at scale — up to 2x throughput and smoother latency for long-context LLMs."

Tom: One more ops ask — during canary we'll lock new quantization profiles behind a feature-flag. If the canary fails we'll auto-fallback to v1.4.2. Deploy snippet below for the runbook:```bash
# start canary
deployctl rollout start --release v1.4.3 --canary 10 --timeout 2h
# rollback if needed
deployctl rollout rollback --release v1.4.3
```

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary start Wed 2024-03-13T14:00:00-07:00. Notifying eng-oncall.

ali: Posted docs link: https://docs.redwood.in/release/v1.4.3 (live). I also added a short "What's new" header — text: "Improved inference throughput and latency for long-context models; smarter batching and safer rollouts."

jess: Thanks — marketing to finalize blog + social copy by Wed EOD. Can someone from eng confirm there's no embargo/legal hold? (cc @eric)

eric: No legal holds. We should embargo partner comms until Thu 9:45am PT (15m before public). Also confirming webinar slot Thu 11:30am PT with product demos — we'd like a brief slide on the benchmark methods.

jess: Great. Action items: Tom — lock canary + monitor; Ali — confirm docs blurb pushed (done); Eric — prepare a 1-slide benchmark methods summary; Marketing — finalize copy and schedule post for Thu 10:00am PT and social cadence. Will post a final preflight checklist here Wed 6pm PT. :thumbsup:

Tom: Roger. I'll post canary health checks and an alert channel link when the rollout starts.

deploy-bot: Canary started. Monitoring channels: #release-health, #eng-oncall.

jess: Thanks everyone — feel free to ping me in DMs for any last-minute asks.
